editorial_review.scope: All 36 verses aligned then reread against native Hebrew by lemma and French occurrence.
notes: Gen 37:1–11: age and kinship idioms, repeated dream expressions, emphatic verbal constructions, and LSG rendering of the tunic.
Gen 37:12–28: discourse-supplied names, directions, health and safety idioms, blood and hand expressions, and the silver price; source wording unchanged.
Gen 37:29–36: grief expressions, repeated tearing predicate and nominal clauses; retained the LSG forms without rewriting the source.
editorial_review.limitations: Both editorial passes by same editor; no independent audit or dictionary-sense verification. Publication checks deferred.
